repomind-ai.title: Stop 3: Tech Street

clipper.title: Stop 4: Film Market

mimic-hunt.title: Stop 5: The Mansion
mimic-hunt.say: Careful in here. The furniture might be a person.

mimic.brief: I'm hiding in this room, disguised as furniture. You have 3 shots. Watch for something that blinks.
misses: In the real game, shooting a decoy costs you double.
mimic.found: Found me! In the real game a whole mansion hides players like this, and the server never tells a Hunter where a hider is unless they could see them.
mimic.lost: Out of shots. I was the lamp all along. Hunters lose a lot of rounds like this one.

mimic-hunt.brief: Welcome to the mansion. Everything looks normal, except the furniture is alive. It moves when you're not looking. One piece is me. Watch for a blink, use the radar, and ram the right one. You have 3 shots.
mimic-hunt.hint: Watch for a blink. Trust nothing.
mimic-hunt.lost: Out of shots. I was the {prop} all along. Hunters lose a lot of rounds like this one.

lines.moved: Wait... was that chair always there?
lines.swap: Did those two just swap places?!
lines.radar: Radar says it's somewhere in that ring. Somewhere.

solvefx.brief: 2 AM. One more LeetCode problem, then sleep. Then the hostel lights go out, and every verdict I've ever got comes looking for me.
solvefx.how: Move with the arrow keys or WASD. Grab 5 ACCEPTED tokens. Each one is a shield that debugs anything you touch. Then beat the boss.
solvefx.howTouch: Hold your finger where you want to go. Grab 5 ACCEPTED tokens. Each one is a shield. Then beat the boss.
solvefx.hudBoss: Grab a shield, then ram the clock

lines.tle: Why is the clock running at me?
lines.rte: It teleports?! That's not in the docs.
lines.boss: That's not a clock. That's my nightmare.
lines.won: All test cases passed. Going to bed. Probably.

hits: That one's going on my wall.
SolveFX, why are you like this?
One more and I'm switching to Excel.
solvefx.won: Accepted. That is SolveFX: every LeetCode verdict gets its own overlay and sound, from a fake shutdown to a crash screen. You just met them all.
solvefx.lost: Time's up. Shutting down... That is SolveFX's real Time Limit screen. Every LeetCode verdict gets its own, and you just met most of them.

ipl-auction.brief: You're the auctioneer. Nine AI franchises are bidding, with the same personalities as the bots in my real game: Moneyball, Star Chaser, Balanced Builder and Opportunist. They are not okay today.
ipl-auction.how: Press 1 to 9, or click, to reject any team flashing red: it's bidding money it doesn't have. Press Space on GOING TWICE to bring the hammer down. Too early starts a bid war.
ipl-auction.howTouch: Tap any team flashing red: it's bidding money it doesn't have. Tap the hammer on GOING TWICE. Too early starts a bid war.

lots.name: Byte Kumar
lots.say: Lot one. Nice and calm. A totally normal auction.

lots.name: Chintu Compiler
lots.say: A 91-rated bowler. The Star Chasers are breathing heavily.

ipl-auction.lostMind: MERGE CONFLICTS HAVE LOST THEIR MINDS!
ipl-auction.visitor: A PADDLE FROM OUTSIDE THE ROOM!
ipl-auction.wonHead: Auctioneer survives the most chaotic auction ever
ipl-auction.riotSub: Officials blame purses that were mostly imaginary.

lines.mind: Star Chaser bots pay for stars. That's a whole purse on one bowler.
lines.war: Three teams bidding money they don't have. Catch them!
lines.visitor: Hold on. Is that... you? You're bidding on me?
lines.riot: I've lost control of the room.

ipl-auction.won: Sold, to you. In the real game, 9 bots with these personalities bid on 323 players live over Socket.IO, and they mostly behave.
ipl-auction.lost: The bots won. In the real game they come from reinforcement learning experiments, and they mostly behave. Mostly.

repomind-ai.brief: This building is the ShopWise codebase: routers on top, services in the middle, repositories at the bottom. Bad commits keep landing on the roof, and the bugs they bring drill shortcuts that skip a layer. RepoMind calls that drift.
repomind-ai.how: Arrow keys or WASD to run, up and down to change floors. Run into bugs to squash them. Stand on a red shortcut on the SERVICES floor to refactor it. Keep the building up for 36 seconds.
repomind-ai.howTouch: Tap where you want to go. Run into bugs to squash them. Stand on a red shortcut on the SERVICES floor to refactor it. Keep the building up for 36 seconds.
repomind-ai.hud: Squash bugs · fix red shortcuts on SERVICES
commits: Live stock level on the product page
Quick fix, will clean up later

lines.force: Who pushes to main on a Friday?!
lines.violation: A router is calling the repository directly. That's drift.
lines.burning: The services floor is on fire. This is fine.
lines.won: Still standing. RepoMind would have flagged every one of those.

repomind-ai.collapseSub: Health 0. RepoMind would have flagged the first shortcut on the day it was committed.
repomind-ai.wonSub: The real RepoMind rebuilds this graph at every commit, and caught 150 of 150 seeded violations in its test suite.
repomind-ai.won: The building held. RepoMind does this for real: it rebuilds a repo's architecture at every commit and flags the moment a layer gets skipped.
repomind-ai.lost: The building fell. That's why RepoMind exists: it flags the first shortcut on the day it's committed.

clipper.brief: Congratulations, you're a film director. Clipper found these moments in a real 20-minute interview. Cut the best three into a trailer before the editing software falls apart.
clipper.how: Click a clip, or press Space when it's under the yellow playhead, to put it in the trailer. Things will break. Press F or click the fan if the GPU overheats.
clipper.howTouch: Tap a clip to put it in the trailer. Things will break. Tap the fan if the GPU overheats.
clipper.subtitle: Captions: "the sauce of the cricket is in the refrigerator"

lines.captions: That is NOT what he said.
lines.hot: The GPU is cooking. Cool it down!
lines.intern: Out of time. The intern picked the rest.

reviews: I laughed, I cried, I understood about 58% of it.
Some of it was a clever plan. Some of it was garbled.
Three minutes of a man explaining his diet.
clipper.twist: Clipper really scores moments like this, on my own laptop. Its first real run broke the same way: a garbled transcript at 58% confidence (fixed to 78%), and a missing GPU library that made it take 51 minutes instead of 3.6.
